sources.entry: Agenda - Date-focused note taking app for both planning and documenting your projects. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1287445660?platform=mac)

summary.name: Agenda
summary.one_liner: Agenda is a date-focused note-taking app that organizes notes into a project timeline and merges them with calendar events and reminders.
use_cases: Planning projects on a dated timeline
Tracking tasks with checklists and reminders
Clipping web pages and files into notes
Searching and asking questions about past notes
Sharing notes or projects as PDF, RTF or Markdown
summary.what_it_does: Agenda stores notes in a timeline per project, so past, present and future notes appear together, and notes can be dated or linked to calendar events. Notes are styled text, supporting headings, lists, checklists, tables, tags and links, and can be converted to Markdown and HTML. Reminders added from notes appear in the Reminders app, and a single timeline shows calendar events and due reminders. Users can attach files, links and photos, clip web pages from Safari, and send notes by email to a private address. Notes sync across Mac, iPhone and iPad through iCloud or Dropbox. The page also describes an on-device "Ask Agenda" feature and, on Mac, connecting an AI assistant via Model Context Protocol.
notable: Organizes notes on a date-based timeline that tracks past, present and future together
Syncs via the user's own iCloud or Dropbox account, with notes not accessible to the developer
Ask Agenda answers questions about your notes on-device, and Mac supports MCP connections to AI assistants
Apple Design Award winning app according to the page
caveats: Premium features are mentioned but their pricing and contents are not detailed on the page
Requires macOS 12, iOS 15, or iPadOS 15 or higher
Some features such as the Mac AI assistant connection and Apple Pencil drawing are platform-specific
